units.italian: Mentre la piccola creatura traduce per te, la Regina sembra ridere in uno strano modo, con un suono di cinguettio. "Gli Erabu sono gli aristocratici della mia terra. Attaccarli è un grave reato," traduce la creatura per la Regina. "Cosa hai da dire a tua discolpa?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"Whoever I attacked, I was only defending myself."|183|0
units.english: "Whoever I attacked, I was only defending myself."
units.italian: "Chiunque io abbia attaccato, mi stavo solo difendendo."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	"Well, then for that I apologize."|185|0

mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	As the small creature translates for you, the Queen seems to laugh in a strange chittering way. "Yes, my royal guards are rather... eager to defend, and for that I apologize," the creature translates as the Queen speaks. "But would my royal guard truly be doing its duty if it were not defending my lands from unknown threats? Although, perhaps they could be more patient in assessing true threats. I might punish those responsible, but it would seem that you have already dealt with those who have slighted you."|191|0
units.english: As the small creature translates for you, the Queen seems to laugh in a strange chittering way. "Yes, my royal guards are rather... eager to defend, and for that I apologize," the creature translates as the Queen speaks. "But would my royal guard truly be doing its duty if it were not defending my lands from unknown threats? Although, perhaps they could be more patient in assessing true threats. I might punish those responsible, but it would seem that you have already dealt with those who have slighted you."
units.italian: Mentre la piccola creatura traduce per te, la Regina sembra ridere in uno strano modo, con un suono di cinguettio. "Sì, la mia guardia reale è piuttosto... ansiosa di difendere, e per questo mi scuso," traduce la creatura mentre la Regina parla. "Ma la mia guardia reale farebbe davvero il proprio dovere se non difendesse le mie terre da minacce sconosciute? Anche se, forse, potrebbe essere più paziente nel valutare le minacce vere. Potrei punire i responsabili, ma sembra che tu abbia già sistemato chi ti ha offeso."

Potrei punire i responsabili, ma sembra che tu abbia già sistemato chi ti ha offeso."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Bunrodea (Hostile)|	As the small creature translates for you, the Queen steps off of her throne and approaches you. She extends her legs so that she towers over you to at least twice your height. She speaks, and the creature translates. "How flippant you are, to lie like that in front of the highest royalty. You're either extremely brave, or extremely stupid." The Queen turns around and returns to her throne. "I will show mercy, just this once. But you will not be so fortunate the next time."|199|0
units.english: As the small creature translates for you, the Queen steps off of her throne and approaches you. She extends her legs so that she towers over you to at least twice your height. She speaks, and the creature translates. "How flippant you are, to lie like that in front of the highest royalty. You're either extremely brave, or extremely stupid." The Queen turns around and returns to her throne. "I will show mercy, just this once. But you will not be so fortunate the next time."
units.italian: Mentre la piccola creatura traduce per te, la Regina scende dal trono e si avvicina. Allunga le zampe così da torreggiare su di te per almeno il doppio della tua altezza. Parla, e la creatura traduce. "Quanto sei sfacciato, a mentire così davanti alla più alta autorità reale. O sei estremamente coraggioso, o estremamente stupido." La Regina si volta e torna al trono. "Mostrerò clemenza, solo per questa volta. Ma non sarai così fortunato la prossima."
